entities.summary: Daniel Sea is an American filmmaker, actor and musician. They rose to prominence through their role as Max Sweeney on The L Word (2006–2009), the first recurring transmasculine role on television. In 2022, they reprised the role for the sequel series The L Word: Generation Q. They have also acted in films such as Shortbus (2006), Itty Bitty Titty Committee (2007) and The Casserole Club (2011).
